description:
Actions of this tool: karea_create_project, karea_create_category, karea_share_project. These are actions, not tools: call karea_projects_write with action="karea_create_project" (or another name above) and its arguments in params; there is no tool named after an action.

Create a project or a category inside one, or share a project with someone by email.

Pass one of these as `action`, with its arguments in `params`:
- karea_create_project - Create a new Karea project owned by you and seed it with the default categories (Coding, Testing, Documenting, Reviewing). [required: name]
- karea_create_category - Create a new category (a task bucket) inside an existing project and return it. [required: name; optional: projectId]
- karea_share_project - Give another user access to a project by email at a chosen role (owner, editor, commenter or viewer). [required: project, email; optional: role]

For the full parameter schema of any action, call karea_help with that action name.

action.description: Which operation to perform: one of the actions listed in this tool's description (an action name, not a tool name).

params.description: Arguments for the chosen action, as an object. Omit for actions that take none.

name: karea_projects_write
title: Create and share projects
